Fig. 6.2 is a newspaper article about the impact of global warming.
A crisis that we cannot ignore.
The impact we are now having was first seen with the extinction of the
dodo in 1681. The increase in human population has been a key factor as
it reduces the habitat for animals and plants. However, this reduction in
habitats could be slowed down if we used existing resources better. Air and
water pollution are also significant, whilst in the oceans, overfishing and
plastic pollution have had a big impact. Global warming will make these
factors much worse.
